statements.statement_en: Israel should apply its sovereignty to parts of Judea and Samaria (the West Bank), even if this harms relations with Israel's allies.
Israel should cut economic ties with hostile states, territories and organizations, including trade, money transfers and aid agencies, even if civilians there are harmed.
Yeshiva students should be drafted into the army or civilian service, even if this forces them to give up full-time Torah study.
Israel should reduce the number of foreign workers, even if construction, agriculture and elderly care become more expensive.
Getting a divorce should be easier, even if one of the spouses objects.
The Supreme Court should have less power to cancel laws and government decisions, even if citizens have fewer ways to challenge them in court.
Teachers, lecturers and public employees who express support for terrorism should be dismissed, even without a criminal conviction.
Therapy that tries to change a minor's sexual orientation should be banned, even if parents want it for their child.
